painter.note: Every published result: painter V096 · sim 100 · judges J1 · release 0.1.0. V1-V3 used the models' own toolkit on this painter's simulator; V4/V5 used the V096 pipeline (unpublished benchmark build, same recipe).

scoring.tries: Best of 3: only tries 1–3; xhigh where reasoning effort is supported
scoring.composite: mean of the vision-judge overall and the classic-metrics mean, 0 to 10
scoring.indexed: composite as a percentage of the target scored against itself (crops[].selfScore); models rank by the mean indexed score, with its own bootstrap interval
scoring.ci: 95% percentile bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 7) of the mean over all scored paintings of a model in a round
scoring.judgeProviders: V1 to V3 judges ran on Together. In V4 and V5, later judge calls went through OpenRouter to zero-data-retention providers; each painting lists them under judgeProviders.

roundCompare.method: Paired by model. Each model scores the mean of all its scored paintings in a round; the difference is skill minus naive per model, averaged with each model weighted equally. 95% CI: percentile bootstrap over models (10,000 resamples). Models need at least 5 scored paintings in both rounds.
